**

El Torero in Tirol

** **

Welcome to El Torero – your authentic Spanish tapas bar in the heart of Tirol!

** **

Authentic Flavors from Spain in the Alps

** **

In the midst of the breathtaking landscapes of Tirol, we bring you the vibrant spirit of Spain. At El Torero, you’ll find a cozy yet lively atmosphere where traditional Spanish tapas meet Alpine charm. Whether you’re craving a hearty Paella or a refreshing Sangría, our menu offers a taste of Spain’s finest – all while enjoying the stunning backdrop of Tirol.

** **

Our Highlights

** **
    ** **
  • Tapas & Small Plates: Savor classics like Patatas Bravas, Gambas al Ajillo, and Croquetas, paired with our house-made Pan con Tomate.
    • ** **
  • Main Dishes: Indulge in our slow-cooked Cochinillo Asado or a flavorful Pulpo a la Gallega.
    • ** **
  • Drinks: Raise a glass of our signature Sangría or enjoy a cold Mahou or Estrella Damm.
    • ** **
  • Desserts: End your meal with a sweet Churros con Chocolate or a slice of Tarta de Santiago.
    • ** **
** **

Location & Atmosphere

** **

Nestled in the lively center of Innsbruck, El Torero is just a stone’s throw away from the Goldenes Dachl and the Hofburg. Our rustic yet modern interior, adorned with warm wooden beams and colorful tiles, transports you straight to the sun-drenched streets of Andalucía – without leaving Tirol.

** **

Whether you’re here for a romantic dinner, a casual get-together with friends, or a business meeting with a Spanish twist, El Torero promises an unforgettable experience.

** **

Visit Us

** **

Come by for a taste of Spain in the Alps! We’re open daily from 12:00 PM to midnight – your Tapas adventure in Tirol awaits.
